title: Lawrence Krauss inviting Joe Rogan to Epstein Island

tellings.quote: Who invited Rogan to Epstein Island?

plain: The story is that the physicist Lawrence Krauss invited the podcaster Joe Rogan to Jeffrey Epstein's private island in the US Virgin Islands. The comedian Kurt Metzger raises it on the show by asking, "Who invited Rogan to Epstein Island?", in a conversation about Epstein and the people around him. If true, it would link a well-known scientist to bringing a famous broadcaster into Epstein's circle.
